lines.text: The Elementary Education option provides opportuni-
ties for students to explore a variety of subjects in the
humanities, social sciences, and natural sciences.
Students also learn appropriate strategies and the inter-
personal skills essential to provide successful learning
experiences for children in a diverse society.
***FYEX 1110 First-Year Seminar is required for all
degree-seeking students with fewer than 30 credit
hours successfully completed including transfer credits.
